title: Extend the Type A factor gauge to every real body-sign profile (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Prove one diagonal sign conjugacy for every independent real body-sign profile of the fixed 20-factor Type A circuit in ToikY's #7439. Claim type: **scoped computer-assisted proof with an exact character-ring certificate**. No new κ.

```text
E_jj = E_(18+j,18+j) = product_(r=1 to min(max(j-1,0),8)) D_r
T_i(D) = E(D) T_i(1) E(D)^(-1)       for every selected i
```

The earlier one-body gauge extends to all 17 simultaneous signs. Consequently the cited unit-body 19-factor witness transfers to every real body-sign profile. The predecessor's witness, minimum-length theorem and paid comparison are cited premises, not replay deliverables. The new result, proof and checkers were produced by Nick Petalas.

The package retains the exact literal caller from #7439 head `ba83c9bebd99502cd64bb1cab2bc4e5336d9d7b2`, originally supplied by rohanarun in #7113. It needs no foreign Git commit or network during replay. Credit ToikY for the selected circuit and real-body opening, rohanarun for the signed caller, Clear1nsight for #7334, and the retained P104/native lineage.

Card `p104-side-correction` changes scope to this body-sector interface. Base is canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`; selected #7000 remains unchanged. Live PRs, main, merged work and Discussion claims were checked before reservation and commit.

## Evidence

- Before: #7439 supplies the unit-body circuit and one `D8=-1` gauge. After: the new exact rational sign-character calculation proves the common gauge for all independent signs, including every zero displacement entry.
- Primary result: 659 nonzero and 25,261 zero entries; six rejecting controls cover omitted host/idle bodies, incorrect gauges, a changed factor and changed source bytes. Both complete endpoints are checked over the same character ring.
- Separate numerical implementation: negative prefixes and literal suffix transport on 21 nonunit profiles, 544,320 entry comparisons, complete selected products on all basis columns, and 21 rejected factor omissions. It imports no executable predecessor or primary-checker code. Both implementations were produced by the same contributor.
- Registered replay, direct replay, optimized primary replay, AST compilation, whitespace checks, committed bytes/modes/source-history checks and a read-only Git-free exported replay pass. Exported receipts match the committed package's local receipts.
- CPython 3.12.15 on macOS 27.0.1 arm64. Registered commands took 0.111 s and 2.112 s locally, as replay-budget measurements, with 120-second limits each.

Exact reproduction from the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/p104-real-body-factor-gauge/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/p104-real-body-factor-gauge/independent.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-real-body-factor-gauge
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-real-body-factor-gauge --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Use a local CPython 3.12 path on another machine. See `research/p104-real-body-factor-gauge/PROOF.md` for the exact claim and proof.

## Limitations

Only the fixed normalized circuit, real body signs and central signs `q=±1` are covered. Arbitrary complex bodies, imaginary central sectors, native host reuse, physical sign synthesis, ownership/restoration and complete pricing are unproved. No selected-supplier replay, independent human review, proof-kernel acceptance or complete multiplication theorem is claimed. The price obstruction in #7439 and fixed-frame host-reuse obstruction in #7457 remain intact.

## Open next questions

- Extend the literal character calculation to fourth-root bodies and imaginary central signs; the real-sign simplifications and scalar relative-endpoint premise need replacement.
- Give one changed negative-prefix frame a physical host delivery while preserving its body, mate and ownership contracts, outside #7457's fixed-frame obstruction. No favorable complete bill is supplied.

## CI notes

**CI did not certify this package.** At unchanged head `bbaac094a8368bcb49c586d95e2c7975ac43f119`, [run 43291118984](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43291118984), [plan job 131437302165](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43291118984/job/131437302165), failed in `Onboarding helper tests`. I read the job log: exactly one of 760 tests failed, with 24 skipped. The failing test is `test_research_current_status.CurrentCiNavigationTests.test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`, at `tests/test_research_current_status.py:58`. Its AssertionError says that '`make frontier7000-verify`' is not found in the CI verification document, whose current section still describes #6030.

This mismatch exists in canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`: `certificates/selected-result.json` names `make frontier7000-verify`, while `docs/ci-verification.md` still names #6030. Both files and the test are unchanged by this PR. I also read the failed-step logs of [run 42905094314](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42905094314) and [run 43291152300](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43291152300); each has the same single failing test, the same missing-command assertion, and `FAILED (failures=1, skipped=24)` after 760 tests.

The package `replay` job was skipped because `plan` failed. The successful package checks described above are local evidence only. No fix, retrigger commit or job rerun was made; the repository-level repair is left to maintainers.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way. This adds one isolated research package.

**Blast Radius:** package. Shared code, selected records and predecessor packages are unchanged.
